title: IMU Filter
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multisensor Positioning/Navigation Filters/IMU_Filter.md
text: Estimate orientation using IMU Filter, 2 inputs, 2 outputs; {Reference frame} sets the navigation reference frame, {Orientation format} sets the orientation output format, {Decimation factor}, {Initial process noise}, {Accelerometer noise ((m/s 2 ) 2 )} sets the variance of accelerometer signal noise, {Gyroscope noise ((rad/s) 2 )} sets the variance of gyroscope signal noise, {Gyroscope drift noise ((rad/s) 2 )} sets the variance of gyroscope offset drift, {Linear acceleration noise ((m/s 2 ) 2 )} sets the variance of linear acceleration noise, {Linear acceleration decay factor} sets the decay factor for linear acceleration drift and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Accel
ports.summary: Accelerometer readings in sensor body coordinate system (m/s 2 ) matrix

ports.name: Gyro
ports.summary: Gyroscope readings in sensor body coordinate system (rad/s) matrix

ports.name: Orientation
ports.summary: Orientation of sensor body frame relative to navigation frame matrix | array

ports.name: Angular Velocity
ports.summary: Angular velocity in sensor body coordinate system (rad/s) matrix

params.name: Orientation format
params.values: Orientation output format quaternion (default) | Rotation Matrix

params.name: Initial process noise
params.values: Initial process noise imufilter.defaultProcessNoise (default) | 9-by-9 matrix of real numbers

params.name: Accelerometer noise ((m/s 2 ) 2 )
params.values: Variance of accelerometer signal noise (m/s 2 ) 2 0.0001924722 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Gyroscope noise ((rad/s) 2 )
params.values: Variance of gyroscope signal noise (rad/s) 2 9.1385e-5 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Gyroscope drift noise ((rad/s) 2 )
params.values: Variance of gyroscope offset drift (rad/s) 2 3.0462e-13 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Linear acceleration noise ((m/s 2 ) 2 )
params.values: Variance of linear acceleration noise (m/s 2 ) 2 0.0096236100000000012 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Linear acceleration decay factor
params.values: Decay factor for linear acceleration drift 0.5 (default) | scalar in the range [0 1)

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
